sections.text: Testing the 87 T differential unit minimum pickup

items:
Make the test 
 connections as shown in figure 1 for the 87T phase pairs to be tested.

Set the 
 primary and secondary currents to 0.07 (W1) & 0.1 (W2) amperes RMS.

Set primary and 
 secondary current source angles to 0 degrees

Apply the 
 currents.

Slowly raise the 
 current from 0.07 (0.1) amperes RMS until the rlay trips. The contact monitor 
 should indicate a closed contact. The "Differential" target along with the 
 phase target should light. This should occur when the secondary current 
 reaches 0.12 (0.24) amperes RMS 3 %

sections.text:
Testing the 87 T differential unit with adjustable 
percent slope setting

items:
Make the test 
 connections as shown in figure 1 for the 87T phase pairs to be tested.

Set the primary 
 and secondary currents to 0.73 (1.5) amperes RMS.

Set the secondary 
 current source angles to 180 degrees

Apply the 
 currents.

Slowly raise the 
 secondary current RMS until the relay trips. The contact monitor should 
 indicate a closed contact. The "Differential" target along with the phase 
 target should light. This should occur when the secondary current reaches 0.73 
 (1) amperes RMS 3 %

sections.text:
Testing the 87 T differential unit with harmonic
restraint

items:
Make the test 
 connections as shown in figure 1 for the 87T HARM phase pairs to be tested 
 (both sources synchronized and in parallel)

Set current source 
 to 0.40 (0.80) amperes RMS at 0 degrees 50 hz. Set current source 2 to 0.1 (1) 
 amperes RMS at 0 degrees 100 hz

Apply the 
 currents. The TPU-2000R display should read "Trip restrained" Slowly lower 
 only current source 2 from 0.1 (1.5) amperes RMS until the relay trips. The 
 contact monitor should indicate a closed current source 2 is 0.06 (1.24) 
 amperes RMS

Make the test 
 connections as shown in figure 1 from the 87 H phase pairs to be tested.

Set the current 
 source 1 to 2.50 (4.8) amperes RMS at 50 hz.

Set current source 
 2 to 2.50 (4.8) A at 100 Hz Suddenly apply the current for 1 second. The 
 relay should trip. The contact monitor should indicate a closed contact. The 
 "Differential" target along with the phase target light. Go to the fault 
 records and verify that the 87 H unit initiated the last trip.

Return relay to 
 service by removing the test plugs, and switch on test switches.

Check relay 
 configuration and logic
